name: support-triage-agent
description: Read-only support triage workflow: turns customer tickets into evidence-graded triage reports with confidence labels, a known-issue search gate, and a draft customer response.

interface.shortDescription: Evidence-graded, read-only triage of customer support tickets
interface.longDescription: Turns a messy support ticket into a structured triage report: intake, a known-issue search gate, evidence table, root cause with a Confirmed / Likely / Suspected confidence label, escalation decision and a draft customer reply. Read-only by design; writes only under reports/.
defaultPrompt: Triage this support ticket and draft a customer reply
